summary: A lane dispatches at a step only when the lane-step dispatch join admits the lane's capability class at that step's kind: read-only classes reach internal_sqlite and cross_authority steps, editing classes stay on external_effect steps, definition composition derives the action pair placement from the generated join, dispatch time refuses a lane the step kind does not admit, and the generator refuses a lane class the join does not name. Repeals the CD-0059 research-family exclusion (#892).
title: A lane dispatches at the step kinds its capability class admits
